mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.2% is at a historically low level, which reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows and is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.2%, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS level and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it indicates elevated inflation, which typically triggers monetary policy tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL (above 220) and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8% and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 700 thousand units, it signals a weak labor market and declining consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak labor and housing demand regime
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE>8 and HOUST<700, or the correlation between the interaction condition and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8%), the economy is in a recessionary phase, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE>8, or the correlation between UNRATE>8 and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The current level of housing starts (HOUST) at 672 thousand units is below historical norms, indicating weak consumer demand and a contracting housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is at or below 672 thousand units, or the correlation between HOUST level and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650 thousand units, it signals a significant slowdown in the housing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 650 thousand units, or the correlation between HOUST (below 650) and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and GDP growth (GDPC1) is negative year-over-year, it indicates a recessionary economy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO<100 and GDPC1 YoY growth<0, or the correlation between the interaction condition and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 100), the economy is contracting, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO<100, or the correlation between INDPRO<100 and returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
